# Lucid Marketing, by MacRandle Acres

> Jeff Randle helps growing businesses remove friction and accelerate growth. Real estate is one specialty.

## Business

Lucid Marketing, by MacRandle Acres is Jeff Randle's business. He is a fractional growth advisor in Salisbury, Maryland. Each month he looks for hidden opportunities that make a business more profitable, then implements the systems that capture them.

Tagline: Remove Friction. Accelerate Growth.
Values: Growth, Foundation, Freedom, Trust.

The work fits small businesses, service businesses, local businesses, and creators. The plan follows the business, not a single industry.

## Services

- Marketing and growth advisory. Monthly plans find the highest-impact growth moves and put them in motion. Momentum is $997 to $1,250 per month. Growth Partner is $1,997 to $2,500 per month. Rainmaker Elite is $3,500 to $5,000 per month.
- Web design. Custom websites, designed and built to turn visitors into clients, including hosting and launch.
- App development. Custom web apps and mobile apps, from a simple build to a full custom product.
- AI Virtual Employee Setup. Your first AI agent, set up with you on a call, for $149 one-time. It is built around the work that takes the most space on your plate (emails, posting, follow-ups, scheduling), and it is working by the end of the call.
- Real estate specialty. The same growth work, applied to a real estate business. Real estate is one specialty, not the only client type.
